description: UNVERIFIED SCAFFOLD (never built). Capabilities for the single ToolSeer window. Only plugin and core permissions are listed, because that is what Tauri v2's ACL gates; the app's own commands (engine_*, job_*, pick_*) are registered in Rust via generate_handler!. Note there is deliberately NO shell-plugin permission here: the qpdf sidecar is spawned by our own Rust code with an absolute path, so the webview never gains the ability to run a program.
